battle.name: 孫安祖起義
battle.brief: 大業七年（611）冬，清河漳南人孫安祖因家鄉水災妻兒餓死、又遭縣令催逼赴遼東役，殺縣令而聚眾於河北故城西南的高雞泊，自號將軍，成為隋末河北起義的先聲。此役義軍並無攻城器械，遠射只靠弓弩；卡面這件古羅馬扭力式投石機並未在場上，只作「以機械破城」技術譜系的源頭標本。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 這場起義的交戰方，一方是河北清河一線的鄉里武裝，另一方是隋廷的郡縣官軍與地方團練。義軍方面，孫安祖原是清河漳南（今山東武城東北）的平民，殺縣令之後在竇建德掩護下聚眾入高雞泊（今河北衡水故城西南），自號將軍；同一片澤地裡還聚著信都人高士達（自號東海公，以竇建德為司兵）、清河隃縣人張金稱（眾至數萬，據河曲）、平原人劉霸道（屯豆子航，眾十餘萬，號阿舅軍），彼此既並肩又互相爭地，沒有統一指揮系統，也沒有常備建制，人數全靠首領自報。隋廷方面，河北各郡的守備只剩下郡兵與鄉勇，地方官軍以步卒與弩手為骨幹，馬匹與重裝備極少；真正有戰力的是中央派出的宿將，如張須陀、楊義臣、薛世雄，率禁軍與各郡兵搜捕；大業七年三月起，隋煬帝把主力百餘萬人調往遼東，江都、山東、河北一線只剩守成之師。河北的地理也左右了部署：高雞泊是低窪鹼泊，蘆葦、泥灘與水面縱橫，舟船可達，步兵不利展開，騎兵更難馳騁，正是流民最容易藏身、又最難用大軍圍死的地方。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict were a local armed force from the Qinghe line in Hebei and the county garrisons and locally raised bands that the Sui court sent against them. On the insurgent side, Sun Anzu had been an ordinary resident of Zhangnan in Qinghe commandery (today the northeast of Wucheng, Shandong); after killing the district magistrate he gathered a crowd with Dou Jiande's cover and entered Gaoji Bo, the marsh southwest of modern Gucheng in Hengshui, Hebei, styling himself General. In the same belt of wetland sat Gao Shida of Xindu, who called himself Duke of Donghai and took Dou Jiande as his Master of Arms; Zhang Jinzheng of Xi county in Qinghe, whose following reached tens of thousands and who held the bend of the river; and Liu Badao of Pingyuan, who drew more than a hundred thousand men to Douzihang and was called the Uncle's Army. These groups stood shoulder to shoulder only in name, competed for the same ground, had no unified command and no standing establishment, and every headcount in the record is a number the leaders themselves reported. On the Sui side, the defence of Hebei had been reduced to county troops and village levies: local soldiers and crossbowmen formed the backbone, with very few horses and almost no heavy equipment. The real weight came from centrally appointed veterans such as Zhang Xutuo, Yang Yichen and Xue Shixiong, who led palace guards and county troops in sweeps. From the third month of the seventh year of Daye the Sui emperor had shifted more than a million men towards Liaodong, leaving only holding formations behind in Jiangdu, Shandong and Hebei. Geography shaped the dispositions as well. Gaoji Bo was a low alkaline lake, a maze of reeds, mud flats and open water reachable by boat, where infantry could not deploy and cavalry could hardly gallop. It was therefore both the easiest place for displaced people to hide and the hardest for a large army to close off.
people: 留下姓名的有三層。第一層是孫安祖本人：清河漳南人，家遭大水漂沒，妻子先後餓死，縣令又逼他服遼東兵役，憤而殺縣令，藏身於竇建德家中；事發之後由竇建德相助，率眾入高雞泊，自號將軍，另有一說自稱「摸羊公」；他後來被同期起義的張金稱所殺，所部歸竇建德。第二層是河北一線的其他首領：竇建德因勇武被選為二百人長，因助孫安祖聚眾被官府追捕，家屬被殺，遂率所部二百人起兵，投高雞泊高士達，高士達戰死後他成為河北義軍主將；張金稱眾至數萬，大業十二年（616）被楊義臣擊滅；劉霸道以阿舅軍之名聚眾十餘萬；高士達自號東海公。第三層是隋廷與地方將領：張須陀是隋朝在山東最見效力的剿匪名將，先在泰山下擊敗王薄，又在高唐一線重創張金稱；大業十二年他率軍追討河北義軍，中了竇建德在童山一線的埋伏，中流矢而歿，士卒死者萬餘，全軍潰散盡歸竇建德；薛世雄、楊義臣先後奉命討平河北與山東各股義軍；隋煬帝本人則往來涿郡與江都，遠離河北戰場。
peopleEn: The record preserves names at three levels. The first is Sun Anzu himself: a man of Zhangnan in Qinghe whose home was swept away by flood, whose wife starved to death, and who was then pressed by the magistrate into taking a labour levy for the Liaodong campaign; enraged, he killed the magistrate and hid in the house of Dou Jiande. After the killing Dou Jiande helped him gather followers and enter Gaoji Bo, where he called himself General; one account says he styled himself the Goat-Snatcher. He was later killed by Zhang Jinzheng, a rebel of the same year, and his men went over to Dou Jiande. The second level is the other leaders of the Hebei line. Dou Jiande, famed for his courage, had been selected as a commander of two hundred men; because he helped Sun Anzu gather followers he was hunted by the authorities and his family was killed, so he rose with his two hundred and joined Gao Shida at Gaoji Bo, and became the leader of the Hebei insurgents after Gao Shida fell in battle. Zhang Jinzheng drew tens of thousands and was destroyed by Yang Yichen in the twelfth year of Daye (616). Liu Badao assembled more than a hundred thousand under the name of the Uncle's Army, and Gao Shida called himself Duke of Donghai. The third level is the Sui command: Zhang Xutuo was the most effective enemy of the rebels in Shandong, beating Wang Bo below Mount Tai and badly mauling Zhang Jinzheng near Gaotang. In the twelfth year of Daye he led troops against the Hebei insurgents, walked into an ambush laid by Dou Jiande at Tongshan, was struck by an arrow and died, more than ten thousand of his soldiers fell with him, and his entire command broke up and went to Dou Jiande. Xue Shixiong and Yang Yichen in turn received orders to clear the various rebel bands in Hebei and Shandong, while the Sui emperor himself moved between Youzhou and Jiangdu, far from the fighting in Hebei.
kits: 卡面上的投石機是古羅馬的扭力式拋石器（onager），卡片標公元前二百五十年，靠扭力弓臂儲存的彈性把石彈甩出；維特魯威在《建築十書》裡記述過同類機器的機架比例與投臂長度。它距本役八百六十餘年，羅馬的扭力拋射器從未傳入東亞，所以這件兵器不會出現在六一一年的河北，只能當作「把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭」這條技術譜系的源頭標本來讀。真正與它佔同一位置的中原器械是砲：隋軍序列中的發石車、霹靂車（車上合裝弩砲與石砲）、巢車、雲梯、撞車與飛雲梯；第三次征高句麗時隋軍即攜飛雲閣隨行，閣高十餘丈、閣上施弩數十，這是史籍為這批器械留下的具體尺度。義軍一側則幾乎沒有攻城器械：高雞泊一帶是沼澤，無城可攻，有力也未必攻城，手段是柴草堆塞門戶、穴地掘進、火攻與撞木；兵器多為削尖的竹木杆、漁叉、耙叉、鐮斧與環首刀，弓以素木弓為主，弩極少，皮甲與布甲零星，馬匹缺乏；糧食靠搶收田禾與村寨徵集，運輸靠步力、漁船與少量畜力車。整套裝備體系說明：這是一場以人數、地形與流動性取勝的鄉里起事，器械作戰在起義方幾乎缺席，拋射火力只由弓弩承擔。
kitsEn: The onager on this card is the Roman torsion stone-thrower, dated to 250 BC: the elastic force stored in a twisted bow arm is released to fling the stone, and Vitruvius described the frame proportions and arm lengths of machines of this kind in the De architectura. It stands more than eight hundred and sixty years away from this campaign, and the Roman torsion thrower never reached East Asia, so the weapon cannot have been present in Hebei in 611. It can only be read as the ancestral specimen of the technical lineage that turns the potential energy of a windlass into a stone, and siege warfare from that point on possessed a calculable destructive power. The Chinese machine that stood in the same functional slot was the po: the stone-throwers, the thunder-crash carts that combined crossbows and stone engines on a single frame, the siege towers, the scaling ladders, the battering rams and the flying cloud ladders of the Sui order of battle. The Sui army on its third campaign against Goguryeo marched with flying cloud towers, more than ten fathoms high, carrying dozens of crossbows on their upper decks, and that is the concrete measure the records preserve for this family of machines. The insurgents, by contrast, had almost no siege equipment at all. Gaoji Bo was a marsh: there was no city for them to attack, and hardly the strength to attack one if there had been, so their methods were to stuff doorways with brushwood, to dig in under the walls, to set fires and to push in with a ram. Their weapons were mostly sharpened bamboo and wooden poles, fish spears, pitchfork tines, sickles and ring-pommel swords; their bows were plain wooden bows; crossbows were rare; leather and cloth armour was sporadic; horses were scarce. Food came from seizing standing grain in the fields and pressing village households, and transport was by manpower, by fishing boat and by a few draft animals. The whole equipment system says the same thing: this was a village rising fought on numbers, on terrain and on mobility, and the machine side of warfare was almost entirely absent from the insurgents, with the bow and the crossbow carrying all of the long-range weight.
tactics: 義軍的打法是典型鄉民起事：先在隱蔽地帶屯聚，人數不足以攻城便不作強攻，多作流動打擊——襲擊縣城、截斷郡縣間的糧道、驅散糧車、趁官軍分散時襲其營伍。孫安祖刺殺縣令之後，竇建德助其聚眾入高雞泊，義軍即以澤地為根，靠村落、族里與水網維持募兵與補給，隨時可以化整為零、重新集結。官軍的處置則以搜捕與封鎖為主：郡兵與鄉勇沿渡口、驛道與鹽場巡查，切斷義軍與糧產的聯繫，把起兵眾壓在澤地一線；一旦成建制的官軍進攻，義軍多半退入水網，以船隊轉移、以蘆葦與泥灘遲滯追兵。這套「不守城、不決戰、只斷糧」的辦法之所以有效，正是因為隋朝在遼東方向抽走了主力，河北只餘郡兵。同一條鏈條上的其他起義也循同樣節奏：同年王薄在鄒平長白山作《無向遼東浪死歌》號召拒役，張金稱據河曲，劉霸道的阿舅軍屯豆子航，河北與山東在同一年形成互相聲援、互不隸屬的武裝網。攻城技術在本役幾無施展余地，投石一類的拋射火力只可能出現在後來義軍進逼郡城、隋軍反攻據點的場合，用途是壓制城頭、守住營壘，而不是決定戰局。
tacticsEn: The insurgents fought in the classic manner of a village rising. They first massed in concealed ground; when they were not strong enough to take a city they did not try, and preferred fluid strikes instead: raiding county seats, cutting the grain roads between commanderies, driving off grain carts, falling on isolated detachments whenever the government troops scattered. After Sun Anzu killed the magistrate, Dou Jiande helped him gather a crowd into Gaoji Bo, and from then on the insurgents took the wetland as their root, drawing recruits and supply through villages, kin groups and the water network, able at any moment to dissolve into small bands and re-form. The authorities answered with search and blockade. County troops and village levies patrolled the fords, the post roads and the salt pans, cutting the insurgents off from the grain and pressing the rebels back into the marshes. When organised government troops did advance, the insurgents generally withdrew into the water network, shifting position by boat and using the reeds and mud flats to slow the pursuit. This method of not holding cities, not seeking a pitched battle, and simply cutting grain worked precisely because the Sui state had pulled its main strength towards Liaodong, leaving Hebei nothing but county troops. The other risings on the same chain moved to the same rhythm: in the same year Wang Bo raised men at Changbai in Zoupin and composed his 'Song of Marching to the East to Die' to rally men against the levy, Zhang Jinzheng held the river bend, and Liu Badao's Uncle's Army sat at Douzihang, so that Hebei and Shandong in that single year formed a web of armed bands that supported one another without any subordination. Siegecraft had almost no room in this campaign. Stone-throwing power of the onager sort could only have appeared later, when the insurgents pressed against commandery seats and the Sui army came back to storm their strongholds, and there its purpose was to silence the walls and hold a camp, not to decide a battle.
data: 能核對的數字不多，但有幾個支點。役因方面，隋煬帝大業七年再征高句麗，《資治通鑑》記當年調集「天下兵馬百十三萬餘人」，另有大批轉輸丁匠隨軍；河北所出的丁役與糧秣，正是這支大軍的組成部分。河北義軍的規模，則分散在幾部史書裡：竇建德初起只有二百人，其後萬餘；張金稱眾至數萬；劉霸道眾十餘萬；孫安祖聚眾入高雞泊，《隋書》一系記其眾至數萬。距離上，清河漳南至高雞泊約數十里，漳南至郡治與涿郡各在百餘里上下，高雞泊至樂壽約百餘里，義軍憑沼澤可在其中數個方向轉移，隋軍卻得沿僅有的堤道與村道推進。器械尺度方面，隋軍攻城器械中記錄最實的是飛雲閣，高十餘丈、閣上施弩數十，另配發石車、撞車與突火車；義軍則連皮甲都靠撿拾官軍遺棄與繳獲，馬匹更少得可憐。時間上，孫安祖起兵在大業七年冬，其部眾在同年併入竇建德；河北局勢則要到大業十二年（616）竇建德以七千眾擊殺涿郡守將郭絢之後才真正定下來，兩者相隔五年有餘。
dataEn: There are not many figures that can be checked, but there are a few anchors. On the cause of the war: the Sui emperor campaigned against Goguryeo again in the seventh year of Daye, and the Zizhi Tongjian records that more than 1,130,000 soldiers and horses were mustered from everywhere, with a great many transport labourers and craftsmen marching with them; the levies and grain taken from Hebei formed part of that host. On the size of the Hebei insurgents, the figures are scattered across several histories: Dou Jiande rose with only two hundred men and later counted more than ten thousand; Zhang Jinzheng drew tens of thousands; Liu Badao claimed more than a hundred thousand; and the Shu records Sun Anzu's gathering at Gaoji Bo as reaching tens of thousands. On distances: Zhangnan in Qinghe to Gaoji Bo is on the order of a few dozen li; from Zhangnan to the commandery seat and to Youzhou each run a little over a hundred li; from Gaoji Bo to Leshou is about a hundred li. The insurgents could shift across that ground in several directions thanks to the marsh, while the Sui army had to advance along the few dyke tracks and village roads. On the scale of the machines, the best-attested Sui siege device is the flying cloud tower, more than ten fathoms high, carrying dozens of crossbows on top, supported by stone-throwers, battering rams and fire carts; the insurgents by contrast could only pick up discarded or captured government armour, and their horses were pitifully few. On timing: Sun Anzu rose in the winter of the seventh year of Daye and his men were folded into Dou Jiande's command in that same year, while the situation in Hebei was only really settled after Dou Jiande killed the Youzhou commander Guo Xun with seven thousand men in the twelfth year (616) — a gap of more than five years between the two.
cause: 打起來的直接起因是役繁加災荒。大業七年隋煬帝再征高句麗，天下丁壯按戶徵發，山東、河北兩處出丁最多；孫安祖所居的清河漳南一帶恰逢大水漂沒，農田絕收，家人相繼餓死，縣令不體恤，反更嚴催其服遼東兵役，逼得他去殺縣令——這是整條因果鏈最典型的兩環：役使把活人往外拉，災荒把活人往死路上推。第二環是權力結構的鬆動：隋朝把主力百餘萬人推往遼東，江都、山東、河北只剩郡兵與鄉勇，郡縣守備近乎空窗，鄉里宗族、地方豪強與散兵游勇遂各自成為武裝核心，竇建德、張金稱、劉霸道、高士達皆出於此類社會層。第三環是隋廷的反應失序：煬帝遠在涿郡與江都之間巡遊，河北的清剿分散歸各郡自行處理，既無統一指揮，也無長期部署，起義得以在澤地與村落之間蔓延；孫安祖之死與其眾之併入竇建德，更說明河北義軍自始便是一個流動的聯盟，而不是單一勢力的獨立戰爭。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the fighting was conscription piled on top of disaster. In the seventh year of Daye the Sui emperor campaigned against Goguryeo once more, and the able-bodied of every household were drawn out by name; Shandong and Hebei gave up the most men. The district of Zhangnan in Qinghe, where Sun Anzu lived, was struck by a great flood, the fields were ruined, his family starved one after another, and the magistrate showed no mercy and instead drove him harder to take the Liaodong levy, which is what pushed him to kill the magistrate. Those are the two most typical links in the chain: the levy pulls living men outward, and the disaster pushes them onto the road to death. The second link is the loosening of the structure of power. With more than a million of the Sui's main strength sent towards Liaodong, Jiangdu, Shandong and Hebei were left with county troops and village levies, and the defence of the counties and commanderies was close to empty; local clans, local magnates and loose soldiers and brigands each became a nucleus of armed force in their own right, and Dou Jiande, Zhang Jinzheng, Liu Badao and Gao Shida all came out of that social stratum. The third link is the disorder of the court's response. The emperor travelled between Youzhou and Jiangdu far from the fighting, and the suppression in Hebei was left to each commandery to handle on its own, with neither unified command nor long-term deployment, so that the rising could spread through the marshland and the villages. That Sun Anzu was killed and that his men were absorbed into Dou Jiande's command show too that the Hebei insurgents were from the start a fluid coalition rather than the single war of one power.
impact: 最直接的效果是河北義軍網絡的成形。孫安祖在《隋書·帝紀》裡只佔一行，他的死與部眾的併入竇建德，卻把散在高雞泊一帶的鄉里武裝連成一體；竇建德自此成為河北義軍的主將，大業十二年（616）以七千眾擊殺涿郡守將郭絢，大業十三年（617）正月在樂壽稱長樂王，大業十四年（618）五月稱夏王，一度擁兵十餘萬，成為唐初最難纏的割據者之一；武德四年（621），虎牢關一戰被李世民所破，竇建德被俘，次年死於長安，河北義軍在武德六年（623）劉黑闥再起失敗後才真正收場。往後看，這場起義是隋末民變在河北的第一聲，與同年王薄的長白山起義、張金稱與劉霸道的諸股勢力共同把隋朝的徵役體制逼到崩潰，隋亡唐興的局面由此打開。軍制上的變化同樣深遠：中央常備軍被地方團練取代，作戰重心從徵發大規模會戰移到流動作戰與據點爭奪；技術面上，隋代積累的發石車、飛雲梯、突火車與雲梯在往後的攻城戰中繼續使用，《資治通鑑》記竇建德攻洛陽時造攻城具、積弩於車隨軍而進，正是這條技術線的延續。
impactEn: The most direct effect was the formation of a network of armed bands across Hebei. Sun Anzu occupies a single line in the annals of the Book of Sui, yet his death and the absorption of his men into Dou Jiande's command tied the village bands scattered around Gaoji Bo into one body. Dou Jiande became the leader of the Hebei insurgents, killing the Youzhou commander Guo Xun with seven thousand men in the twelfth year of Daye (616), proclaiming himself Prince of Changyue at Leshou in the first month of the thirteenth year (617), and taking the title of King of Xia in the fifth month of the fourteenth year (618), at times commanding more than a hundred thousand men and becoming one of the most difficult separatists the early Tang had to face. In the fourth year of Wude (621) he was broken by Li Shimin at Hulao Pass, taken prisoner, and killed at Chang'an the following year; the Hebei insurgents were only finally closed out when Liu Heita's rising failed in the sixth year of Wude (623). Looking further ahead, this was the first shot fired in Hebei by the peasant insurrections of the late Sui; together with Wang Bo's rising at Changbai in the same year and with the bands of Zhang Jinzheng and Liu Badao it drove the Sui's system of conscription to collapse and opened the situation in which Sui fell and Tang rose. The change in military organisation was equally deep: the central standing army was replaced by locally raised bands, and the centre of gravity in warfare shifted from mass levies and set-piece battles to fluid operations and the contest for strongholds. On the technical side, the stone-throwers, flying cloud ladders, fire carts and scaling ladders accumulated under the Sui went on being used in later siege warfare; the Zizhi Tongjian records that when Dou Jiande attacked Luoyang he built siege engines and stacked his crossbows on wagons to move with the army, which is precisely the continuation of that technical line.
result: 孫安祖本人沒有走到終點。他在高雞泊聚眾之後被同期起義的張金稱所殺，部眾歸竇建德，起義的旗號就此收進河北大軍之中；而清剿這一翼的任務，落到了張須陀、楊義臣、薛世雄等隋將身上。竇建德承接了這批人馬，也承接了孫安祖留下的旗號：大業十二年擊殺涿郡守將郭絢，大業十三年在樂壽稱長樂王，大業十四年稱夏王，武德四年（621）虎牢關兵敗被李世民所擒，次年死於長安，河北的旗號在武德六年隨劉黑闥的失敗而收束。回頭看本役本身的結局，可以確定的是三件事：一是起兵確實發生在大業七年（611）的河北清河，起義者確實在高雞泊一帶聚成了數萬之眾；二是義軍沒有攻城器械，也沒有一次成建制的大會戰，全程以流動、襲擊與斷糧為主；三是史書對孫安祖的記載極為簡略，《隋書》與《資治通鑑》加起來只留下數十字，但正是這數十字，標示出隋朝在河北的統治已開始被鄉里武裝從內部撬動。
resultEn: Sun Anzu himself did not live to see the end. After gathering his crowd at Gaoji Bo he was killed by Zhang Jinzheng, a rebel of the same year, his men went to Dou Jiande, and the banner of the rising was folded into the great Hebei army. The task of suppressing that wing of the country fell to Sui commanders such as Zhang Xutuo, Yang Yichen and Xue Shixiong. Dou Jiande took over both the men and the banner: he killed the Youzhou commander Guo Xun in the twelfth year of Daye, proclaimed himself Prince of Changyue at Leshou in the thirteenth year, and King of Xia in the fourteenth; in the fourth year of Wude (621) he was defeated by Li Shimin at Hulao Pass and taken captive, and he died at Chang'an the following year, while the Hebei banner was finally furled in the sixth year of Wude with the failure of Liu Heita. Looking back at the outcome of this campaign itself, three things can be stated with certainty. First, the rising really did break out in the Qinghe country of Hebei in the seventh year of Daye (611), and the insurgents really did assemble a following of tens of thousands around Gaoji Bo. Second, the insurgents had no siege engines and fought no set-piece battle on any scale; the whole course of the conflict was one of movement, surprise and cutting grain. Third, the record of Sun Anzu in the histories is extremely thin, the Book of Sui and the Zizhi Tongjian between them leaving only a few dozen characters — but it is precisely those few dozen characters that mark how Sui rule in Hebei had begun to be pried loose from within by the armed men of the villages.
